title: `dec2flt::decimal_seq` overflows an `i32` subtraction on a large valid decimal when overflow checks are enabled
author: wpegden
body_preview: When overflow checks are enabled, a valid 2,147,483,650-byte decimal panics in `parse_decimal_seq`:  ```rust d.decimal_point = s.len() as i32 - first.len() as i32; ```  The input is the 32-byte prefix `0.000000000001000000000000000080` followed by `2^31 - 30` zero bytes. At the subtraction, `s.len()` is zero and `first.len()` is `2^31`. The cast of the latter is `i32::MIN`, so `0 - i32::MIN` panic...

title: Rustup proxy slowdown with Rust-Analyzer
author: stefnotch
body_preview: ### Problem  When Rust-Analyzer runs cargo, then it goes through the rustup proxy. Then, the rustup proxy checks which rust toolchain needs to be used. It then calls the correct version of cargo or rustc.  However, this rustup proxy comes with a quite a bit of overhead.
